summary.overall_note: 3 of 30 sampled features are convincingly semantic (6556 classical mechanics, 15175 lagging-strand/Okazaki replication, 6531 DNA alkylation repair), and notably these are crisper, single-subtopic concepts than most of 4096's semantic hits. Even so, the semantic fraction (3/30) is no higher than at 4096, and the high-frequency band is again dominated by Science/Emotion slot-filling templates plus the ubiquitous always-on unit (4068), while the rarest 'alive' band is mostly dead single-token features. Wider capacity here bought sharper individual concepts but not more of them in this sample.
